title: More ways to act on messages
notes: New message actions: copy a sender's name, email address, or subject, write to the sender, reply, and reply all directly from the displayed message.
New /links command lists the links in the displayed message so you can open the one you want in your default browser.
Save every attachment from the displayed message straight to your Downloads folder with the new Save attachments command or /save-attachments.
Use /navigate-top to jump to the top of the message list or compose body.
